exposure: Pre-pregnancy BMI (underweight, normal weight, overweight, obese)
cohort: 3,172 Chinese women in their first trimester of pregnancy
finding: The study recommends specific gestational weight gain ranges for Chinese women based on pre-pregnancy BMI to minimize adverse pregnancy outcomes: underweight (≥8 kg and <12 kg), normal weight (≥12 kg and <14 kg), overweight (≥8 kg and <10 kg), and obese (<8 kg).
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were highest among overweight (53.6%) and obese (53.7%) women.
